PC Errata 2019 disc card of [[Undercover (Dark)]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 17 June 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/ANewHope-Dark/large/undercover.gif undercover.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190617230911/https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/ANewHope-Dark/large/undercover.gif Internet Archive] (17 June 2019, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 4 November 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261104043733/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/ANewHope-Dark/large/undercover.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Undercover (Dark) (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]].
